slides.headline: A high yield, the hard way.

slides.html:
THE YIELD GAP
BBRI DIVIDEND YIELD · TTM
12.2%
Indonesia's 10-year government bond pays 6.78%. The stock offers a 5-point premium over the bond, yet foreign funds are still choosing the bond.
Dividend yield: sectors.app. Bond yield: Trading Economics, Jun 2026.

WHY THE MARKET HESITATES
Profit fell for the first time in years
annual net profit · IDR trillion
Net profit slipped 5.8% in 2025 to IDR 56.7T after two flat years. A 12% payout on shrinking earnings is the market's worry, not its reward.

CREDIT QUALITY
Bad loans are climbing
NPL RATIO · 2025
3.1%
NET PROFIT · YOY
−5.8%
BBRI's micro-lending book feels a rate squeeze first. The bad-loan ratio rose to 3.1%, above the big banks built on cheap deposits.

THE MATH BEHIND THE YIELD
A high yield the hard way
PAYOUT RATIO
87%
P/E · TRAILING
7.2×
SHARE PRICE
IDR 2,840
The yield climbed because the price fell to 7.2× earnings, not because the dividend grew. Payout is already stretched at 87% of a smaller profit.

The yield is real. So is the reason it exists.
Foreign funds moved roughly IDR 105T into Indonesian bonds in June, choosing a steady 6.78% over a 12% payout backed by falling earnings and rising bad loans. The premium is compensation for risk, not a free lunch. The November MSCI review is the market's next checkpoint.
Foreign bond flows: Bank Indonesia via Trading Economics, Jun 2026. Company figures: sectors.app.
